newsitem.title: USA: AST seeks financial support from Samsung.
newsitem.headline: AST seeks financial support from Samsung.

text.p: AST Research Inc said Thursday it had entered a non-binding letter of intent with Samsung Electronics Co to get an additional $200 million in bank credit guarantees.
A statement from AST said the guarantees would come in exchange for shares of AST non-voting preferred stock.

Subject to the execution of a definitive agreement, Samsung will provide AST with a bank credit guarantee of $100 million in December and an additional $100 million next April, both maturing December 31, 1998, AST said.
The new guarantees are in addition to AST's current $200 million in Samsung bank credit guarantees extending through December 31, 1997, AST said.
